title: The Penalty Shootout is Killing Me 😰⚽
script: One kick decides everything. The whole world is watching. The striker walks to the spot. Your heart is in your throat. Silence. The wind stops. The striker runs. And then — GOAL. You scream so loud your neighbors call. Or — saved. The heartbreak is physical. Penalty shootouts take years off your life. And we keep watching. Every single time. Because this is what football does to you.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long brown hair, clutching her face in both hands, watching intently as a striker approaches the penalty spot [Push in on her intensely focused face, eyes wide, mouth slightly open]. She collapses forward in pure relief as the ball hits the net — she screams with hands thrown up [Tracking shot following her explosive reaction]. Second clip: Goalkeeper dives — she throws both fists in the air in triumph [Wide shot of her at the bar area of stadium, arms raised, roaring]. Stadium packed with tense fans behind her, penalty spot lit in dramatic spotlight, slow motion feel, blue and white jersey, cinematic stadium night lighting, 9:16 portrait.
